prompt: Widescreen 16:9 corporate presentation slide, minimalist ultra-luxury. Matte charcoal background. Highly technical clean architectural cross-section blueprint of a building balcony, showing detailed layers of structural steel, soil matrices, and a healthy oak tree root system anchored through root-anchoring grid plates. Crisp emerald green callout lines point cleanly to each component. Clean geometric grid dividers. Crisp white premium sans-serif headline at upper left reading "Active Biomes Transform Concrete Shells Into Net-Positive Power Plants". Smaller white sans-serif subtitle beneath it reading "Our patented structural soil and root-anchoring technology allows full-scale oak trees to grow safely on skyscrapers up to 100 stories high." No clip-art, no stock icons.
style: technical architectural blueprint, minimalist ultra-luxury, sharp typography
